sections.description: A category-based, GDPR-compliant cookie consent banner with tracking integrations and cookie discovery.
sections.changelog:
2.4.3

  • Fix: transport_url wordt nu vroeg in wp_head (priority 0) in de dataLayer gepusht, zodat externe GA4-tags zoals Site Kit en GT-tag alle hits via de sGTM server sturen — ook de eerste page_view. Werkt ook wanneer Google Consent Mode is uitgeschakeld.

2.4.2

  • Fix: Server container URL wordt nu altijd als transport_url gebruikt wanneer ingevuld, ook zonder de 'Server-side tagging inschakelen' checkbox. Verwijderd: dode getGoogleTagBaseUrl() functie. Fix: Updater registreerde dubbele hook waardoor update-checks twee keer werden uitgevoerd. Fix: SQL-queries in cookie discovery gebruiken nu prepare().

2.4.1

  • Fix: GA4 en GTM scripts worden altijd van Google's CDN geladen; de server container URL wordt alleen gebruikt als transport_url voor data collection. Hiermee wordt voorkomen dat sGTM een 400 teruggeeft op /gtag/js en GA4 volledig uitvalt.

2.4.0

  • Feature: Added Google Consent Mode v2 controls, Basic/Advanced mode, configurable consent lifetime, server-side tagging URL, and script-blocking controls.
  • Feature: GA4/GTM can use a server-side tagging endpoint and Advanced mode can load Google tags with denied storage before consent.

2.3.7

  • Debug: Added a safe URL reset flag so the banner can be forced with ?sccb_reset=1 while diagnosing cache or stored consent issues.

2.3.6

  • Fix: Reworked the Leadinfo blocker to avoid global DOM prototype patches that can conflict with cache/defer plugins.
  • Fix: Keeps the cookie banner init path isolated from third-party tracker blocking.

2.3.5

  • Fix: Force update checks now clear the plugin updater cache before reading the remote version.

2.3.4

  • UX: Modal/center banners render as a bottom sheet on mobile.
  • UX: Mobile modal overlay no longer blurs or dims the page background.
  • Privacy: Leadinfo is treated as a marketing tracker and blocked/cleaned when visitors reject optional cookies.

2.3.3

  • Fix: Improved WordPress updater compatibility by using the correct transient hook for plugin updates.
  • Fix: Hardened plugin slug/key matching so update checks target the active plugin reliably.
  • Fix: Added updater cache invalidation after plugin update runs.

2.3.2

  • Fix: Backend layout/position selections are now normalized and always applied consistently.
  • Fix: Added backward compatibility for legacy values like 'popup' and 'central'.
  • UX: Modal/popup now always renders centered, with clear admin help text.

2.3.1

  • Security: Fixed SQL injection risk with prepared statements.
  • Security: Fixed XSS in admin summary (uses textContent).
  • Security: Improved IP detection behind reverse proxies (Cloudflare, nginx).
  • Fix: Cookie discovery now works with page caching plugins.
  • Fix: Removed jQuery dependency for Matomo consent.
  • GDPR: Added consent expiry after 365 days.
  • Performance: Added minified JavaScript (63% smaller).
  • Added uninstall cleanup handler.
